TSS mg/L < 100 3.0 Water for Demineralized (DM) Plant When water evaporates from the cooling tower, dissolved solids remain in the recirculating water. As more water evaporates, the concentration of dissolved solids increases. If the concentration gets too high, the solids can cause scaling and corrosion in the system. For that, part of the circulating water is kept out of the system to limit the dissolved solids in recirculating water within the desirable limits. Based on the requirement, two different types of cooling towers are considered: i) Indirect cooling tower for CCU and other misc. consumers ii) Direct cooling tower for WGS Gas quench tower The indirect cooling water system will cater to the secondary cooling of heat exchanger requirement for CCU and misc. consumers such as compressors, gas turbines, etc. The direct cooling tower shall be used for the quench tower of the WGS unit to bring down the temperature of conditioned BF gas. To optimize makeup water and blowdown water quantity, blowdown water from the CCU cooling tower shall be used as a makeup for the direct cooling water circuit.
